userLatestRead: Discord playtester TuloWodash reported that when clicking fast, grass often appears to disappear.
currentGoal: Make rapid harvesting read as mown/regrowing grass instead of blank or missing grass, without changing touch rewards or regrow timing.

changesMade.summary: Regrowing tiles now render a faded, slightly smaller grass layer over the stubble base in both live tile views and the common render texture.
Accepted manual and persistent touches now keep the touched tile live until the common render texture catches up, even if the normal dirty-tile fallback limit has already been reached.
The faded regrowing grass layer adds one extra common-layer stamp for regrowing tiles; perf harness remained clean with no frame spikes.

verificationRun.result: passed visually; burst-clicked patches retained a faded/mown grass read and live dirty views appeared during the burst.
passed; status complete, visibleTiles about 1200, maxFrameDeltaMs 15 or lower after tap burst, frameSpikes 0, redrawQueued 0, displayObjects settled near 303, activeTweens settled near 21.

currentGitStatus: Gameplay changes are local and uncommitted.

knownIssuesAndRisks: The stress generator can create actual field holes, which can still look like gaps in screenshots; this change targets regrowing/touched tiles, not absent tiles.
Regrowing tiles are now more visibly grassy. If playtesters find them too similar to grown tiles, tune REGROWING_GRASS_ALPHA and REGROWING_GRASS_SCALE in GameScene.ts.
nextRecommendedSteps: Playtest a normal save with rapid clicking and persistent touch to confirm regrowing patches read as mown grass.
If the user wants this shipped, stage only the intended gameplay/handoff files and leave unrelated dirty docs/media alone.
doNotRevert: Do not remove the regrowing grass overlay unless replacing it with another visible mown/regrowing state.
Do not remove the forced live fallback for accepted manual/persistent touches; it prevents rapid input from exposing blank common-layer footprints.
